nativeAcceptance: Material token contract
Native implementation consumes supported Material component and system roles directly; scoped overrides reach the rendered element.
Native dependency boundary
Native CSS and behavior work without the Core theme bridge or legacy token declarations; shared Core utilities have an evidenced semantic match.
Material API and defaults
Anatomy, defaults, variants, sizes and states follow the pinned Material source; Core compatibility lives in a separate entry point.
Compatibility direction
Legacy exports and aliases delegate toward the native implementation without cycles or a second independently maintained value map.
Native consumer preview
The published native entry point renders in docsite and Storybook with source, status and exact revision visible for human QA.
Compose source precedence
Pinned Compose governs overlapping design, behavior and motion; missing concerns and approved exceptions are recorded once per family. Figma-only coverage and native web semantics remain required.
Pixel comparison
Reference and native captures use matched conditions; exact pixel diff passes or a reviewed tolerance exception is recorded.
Motion evidence
Watched reference media, timed frames, interruption, reversal and reduced motion are evidenced, or static behavior has a source-backed N/A.
Compose behavior and tests
Pinned Compose defaults, variants and relevant test cases are mapped to permanent web tests; differences and missing upstream coverage are explicit.
Native response and frame pacing
Recorded browser/device profiles meet the approved input response and frame pacing budgets, including active motion and interruption.
sourcePolicy: Pinned Compose governs overlapping design, defaults, behavior and motion. Figma supplies design gaps and Figma-only coverage; captured Material guidance fills remaining concerns. Web implementation and web standards govern browser semantics. A lower source may fill an evidenced gap; overriding a specified Compose value requires a dimension-specific approved exception. Export or checkout dates alone do not prove freshness. Preserve the complete union of Material 3 and Expressive sources.
